purpose: Define the safe staged path to promote LangGraph from opt-in to default

stages.name: Current state
stages.entry_criteria: Baseline 6ecc495 accepted; Native default; LangGraph opt-in via AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph

stages.name: Opt-in expanded smoke
stages.exit_criteria: Additional scenarios covered; no default change; comparison data collected
stages.evidence_required: New smoke tests comparing Native vs LangGraph outputs and failure modes
stages.rollback_path: Unset AGENT_V2_BACKEND; revert to Native-only test runs

stages.name: Local canary default in isolated shell only
stages.entry_criteria: Stage 01 passed; operator wants hands-on LangGraph default experience
stages.exit_criteria: One terminal/session runs with AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph; logs/traces monitored; no production default changed
stages.evidence_required: Operator log of canary session; trace comparison; issues filed
stages.rollback_path: Close terminal/session; restart with unset env

stages.name: Configurable local default
stages.entry_criteria: All GATE-01 blockers closed; GATE-04 and GATE-08 partial items closed; local canary stable
stages.exit_criteria: Default controlled by explicit config; rollback documented; no hardcoded default change in source
stages.evidence_required: Config-driven default selection test; rollback test; dashboard exposes fallback_reason
stages.rollback_path: Change config value or unset env; restart server

stages.name: Default promotion PR/front
stages.entry_criteria: All gates PASS; human approval obtained; source patch allowed only in this front
stages.exit_criteria: Source patch changes default to LangGraph; full CI green; rollback commit plan documented
stages.evidence_required: Pull request / front report; CI green; parity test suite; rollback runbook
stages.rollback_path: Revert promotion commit or apply pre-prepared rollback commit

stages.name: Knowledge/memory expansion
stages.entry_criteria: LangGraph default stable in production for defined observation period
stages.exit_criteria: Controlled memory promotion flow operational; no unauthorized FAISS rebuilds
stages.evidence_required: Memory promotion front acceptance; retrieval tests; stale-knowledge detection
stages.rollback_path: Disable memory promotion node; revert to read-only memory retrieval

stages.name: Domain-specific agent roles
stages.entry_criteria: LangGraph default stable; memory boundaries proven; tool governance enforced
stages.exit_criteria: Sub-agent roles defined but no broker execution enabled
stages.evidence_required: Role definitions; harness tests; human-gate verification
stages.rollback_path: Disable sub-agent role nodes; return to single-agent graph

notes: No stage enables broker/trading execution without a separate risk-governance front.
Each stage must complete and be accepted before the next stage starts.
Default promotion is intentionally split into multiple fronts to prevent uncontrolled activation.
